impact_map: Topology and routing determine the public product surface.
Source custody and split rights determine what bytes may ship and under what terms.
Checksums, locked trees, and archive parity bind delivered bytes to reviewed bytes.
State behavior affects privacy, recovery, and host isolation.
Documentation parity affects installation, rights understanding, upgrade, support, and recovery.
Workflow governance affects cost and accidental publication exposure.
Static, live-host, hosted-provider, visual, efficacy, and publication claims require different evidence.

invariants.statement: Exactly one Nova plugin exposes 25 visible roots and 16 nested MIND cores.
Imports, persona, notices, source map, and rights hashes match the immutable source lock.
Every physical package file except SHA256SUMS appears exactly once in sorted checksums with a lowercase digest and safe path.
Codex and Claude payloads, standalone folders, and standalone ZIPs match locked source payloads.
Every detached skill retains nova-free-rights and applicable component notices.
Builds are deterministic and state is built_from_frozen_source, never self-approved or published.
Optional state is external to .codex, explicit, atomic, and governed by four selectors.
Docs distinguish license permission, build state, publication, and live behavior.
GitHub workflows are manual and time-bounded; unknown capacity causes HOLD_UNKNOWN and no dispatch.

risks.statement: Topology or source-custody drift exposes a different product than the reviewed Nova Free composition.
Split-license, portable rights-envelope, or component-notice omission creates an incomplete public distribution.
Omitted, duplicate, traversal, or synchronized payload tampering passes a superficial checksum oracle.
Nondeterministic construction or Codex/Claude payload drift delivers unreviewed bytes.
State fallback, implicit initialization, or partial estate writes violate custody and recovery.
Documentation, site, or package drift breaks installation, rights, upgrade, support, or recovery journeys.
Source movement after qualification invalidates the evidence binding.
Builder or metadata prematurely claims independent review, sealing, or publication.
An automatic or unbounded hosted workflow spends capacity or publishes without authority.
Local static evidence is overclaimed as live-host, hosted-provider, visual, accessibility, efficacy, or publication evidence.
Fresh-host installation or invocation fails despite a valid static package.
GitHub-hosted three-operating-system behavior differs from local Windows evidence.
Rendered pages contain visual or accessibility defects not detected by static checks.
One or more specialist skills underperform representative real-world tasks.
